detail.estimand: mean net abnormal return per position
unavailable_data: historical bid-ask quotes (spreads are estimated from daily highs and lows instead)
Trading 212 historical CFD financing rates (a flat assumption is used)
historical borrow availability for shorting small companies
delisting returns for companies that left the exchange (a frozen last price is used: abnormal return = minus the benchmark)
prices for companies no longer listed (they are counted, not traded)
which instruments Trading 212 offered at each past date
financing on long CFD positions (not charged: longs are assumed to be bought as shares in the Invest or ISA account)

survivorship_bounds.label_free_note: adverse_label_free_*: every exit inside the window takes the worst outcome whatever its cause label; a sensitivity, not the robustness test (D10d)
survivorship_bounds.limitations: point estimate only; imputed outcomes are raw stock returns, not benchmark-adjusted; outcome values and the positions-per-event rate are assumptions; companies that changed CIK count as unpriced
